summary: Full backend regression on the secured Microsoft 365 portal. 32/32 pytest tests passed against the public preview URL, covering: auth gating on all /api/finance/* + /api/auth/portal/me (no token, invalid token), single-tenant /api/auth/portal/login auth_url validation (tenant 7f008f30-09bb-4ffe-b661-fa76376ab364, NOT /common or /organizations), full E2E with a manually-injected portal_sessions doc (token=TEST_AUTH_TOKEN_E2E), CRUD on finance entries, LBC purchases, balance update with persistence verification, and confirmation that all OneDrive routes return 404.

minor.issue: Test plan #12 specified payload {amount:45.0} only, but LbcPurchaseCreate model requires `label` (returns 422). Tested both: with label -> 200 OK; amount-only -> 422 (validated as expected). Frontend must always send `label`.

action_items: Confirm with main agent: should LbcPurchaseCreate.label be optional (default '') to match the original test plan payload? Currently it is required.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: AccountBalance PUT echoes the raw user input including `updated_at` overwrite — server forces updated_at=now_iso() which is correct, but the response returns the dict (not a Pydantic-validated model). Fine for this scope.
portal_auth.is_session_active: tolerates malformed expires_at by returning False (good), but no token revocation API beyond /auth/portal/logout. Acceptable for single-user portal.

require_auth: token comparison is by direct equality on a long random secrets.token_urlsafe(48) — adequate (timing-safe not strictly required at this entropy level), but a constant-time compare would be a cheap hardening.
MS_CLIENT_SECRET is committed in /app/backend/.env. Standard for preview env; ensure rotation before production.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/portal/login (state docs accumulate in MongoDB). Consider TTL index on portal_states.created_at.
test_credentials: Manually injected portal_sessions doc: token=TEST_AUTH_TOKEN_E2E, email=contact@solutioninformatique.fr, expires_at=now+30d. Real Microsoft OAuth flow not exercised (interactive).
seed_data_creation: Test session inserted into portal_sessions at module setup, deleted at teardown. All CRUD test data prefixed TEST_E2E_ and cleaned up (entry, lbc purchase, balance restored to original snapshot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is parametrised and idempotent (cleans up portal_sessions, finance_entries, lbc_purchases, account_balance restore). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env and MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/MS_TENANT_ID/PORTAL_ALLOWED_EMAIL from backend/.env. The Microsoft OAuth interactive flow is MOCKED via direct MongoDB session injection — real /api/auth/portal/callback was NOT exercised.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All 14 functional scenarios from the request validated. Single-tenant configuration confirmed: auth_url path contains /7f008f30-09bb-4ffe-b661-fa76376ab364/oauth2/v2.0/authorize. OneDrive routes fully removed (404 on all 4 legacy paths).
